versions.changelog:
Initial release of bilibili-fav-downloader.

- Supports automatic, incremental downloading of Bilibili favorite folders (checks every 2 hours).
- Downloads highest quality video+audio merged as MP4.
- Sends Telegram notifications for new downloads (optional).
- Provides easy guides for obtaining Cookie and favorite folder ID.
- Includes environment setup scripts and crontab automation instructions.
- Requires Python 3.8+, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, and runs on Linux/macOS/WSL.
